message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly:

| Side | Casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|----------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch‑Hessian, Belgian, Prussian, etc.) | **≈ 23 000** |
| French (and their allies) | **≈ 25 000** |

So the combined total was about **48 000** casualties.  These figures are rounded; exact numbers vary slightly among contemporary reports and modern scholarship.
